player_prompt.intro:
Kaiba ka na Player {player_id} ed two-player game na Spite and Malice. So goal mo et na first to empty so payoff pile.

### Game Overview:
- So objective et na clear so payoff pile by playing cards ed center piles.
- Kaiba mo na play cards from three sources:
  1. So **hand** (kaiba mo na start each turn na up to 5 cards ed hand).
  2. So **top card na so payoff pile**.
  3. So **top card na any na so discard piles**.

### Playing Rules:
- Kaiba mo na play card ed center pile no et one rank higher na top card ed that pile (center piles start na Ace tan go up to Queen; Kings ari na wild - ari na play ed any card pero no agi na rank sequence. This means no King ari na play after 4, then that King ari na ranked 5 tan so next card ari na 6).
- No kaiba mo na play any more cards, kaiba mo na discard card ed one na so discard piles to end so turn.
- No center pile ari na reach Queen, ari na clear automatically.
- So rank order et: A=1, 2=2, ..., 9=9, J=10, Q=11, K as wild.

### Actions:
1. **Draw**: Ed start na so turn, draw cards to fill so hand up to 5 cards. Pakipan na **[draw]** to begin.
2. **Play a Card**: To play card, specify so card tan so center pile like this: **[play A♠ 0]** (where 'A♠' et so card tan '0' et so center pile index).
3. **Discard**: No kaiba mo na play any more cards, discard card from hand ed discard pile to end so turn. Pakipan na **[discard A♠ 1]** (where 'A♠' et so card tan '1' et so discard pile index). Note na kaiba mo na discard any card from payoff pile. Kaiba mo na discard only so cards from hand.
